messages.content: 你能告訴我曼聯在英超聯賽過去5輪的比分，以及洛杉磯湖人隊在NBA過去7輪的比分嗎？

function.name: basketball_scores_get_scores
function.description: Retrieve basketball scores for a specific team and league within a certain range of rounds. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The basketball team whose scores are to be retrieved.

league.description: The league in which the team competes.

rounds.description: Number of past rounds for which to retrieve the scores.
